BatchDeleteInstrumentationConfigurations.name: BatchDeleteInstrumentationConfigurations
BatchDeleteInstrumentationConfigurations.documentation:
Deletes multiple instrumentation configurations in a single request. Supports two mutually exclusive modes:

  • Mode 1 (Bulk by scope): Delete all configurations matching a Service + Environment + InstrumentationType
  • Mode 2 (Targeted by ARN): Delete specific configurations by providing a list of resource ARNs

BatchDeleteByResourceArns.documentation: Parameters for targeted delete by ARN list (Mode 2).

BatchDeleteByResourceArnsResourceArnsLis.documentation: List of resource ARNs for batch delete operation (Mode 2). Maximum 50 ARNs per request.

Scope.documentation: Mode 1: Delete all configurations matching the specified scope.

ResourceArns.documentation: Mode 2: Delete specific configurations by ARN list.

BatchDeleteDeletionTarget.documentation: Union type for batch delete target selection. Exactly one of the two modes must be specified.

ResourceArn.documentation: ARN of the configuration that failed to delete.

Code.documentation: Error code indicating the type of failure.

BatchDeleteError.documentation: Represents an error that occurred when attempting to delete a configuration.

BatchDeleteErrorCode.documentation: Error codes for batch delete item-level failures.

BatchDeleteErrorList.documentation: List of errors in batch delete response.

DeletionTarget.documentation: The deletion target - either bulk by scope or targeted by ARN list.

DeletedCount.documentation: Number of configurations successfully deleted. For Mode 1 (scope), this is the total count of deleted items. For Mode 2 (ARN list), this equals the length of SuccessfulDeletions.

SuccessfulDeletions.documentation: List of successfully deleted configurations. Mode 1 populates SignalType and LocationHash per item. Mode 2 populates ResourceArn per item.

Errors.documentation: List of configurations that failed to delete.

ResourceArn.documentation: ARN of the deleted configuration (populated for Mode 2 only).

SignalType.documentation: Signal type of the deleted configuration (populated for Mode 1 only).

LocationHash.documentation: Location hash of the deleted configuration (populated for Mode 1 only).

BatchDeleteSuccessfulDeletionList.documentation: List of successful deletions in batch delete response.

Weight.documentation: Weight assigned to this component in the composite SLI calculation. Must be between 0 and 1. Sum of all component weights must equal 1.0.

OperationName.documentation: Name of the operation. Required for service-level SLOs where multiple operations are aggregated for a single service.

KeyAttributes.documentation: KeyAttributes that identify the service. Required for application-level SLOs where multiple services are aggregated.

CompositeSliMetricComponent.documentation: A composite component representing a single operation (for service-level SLOs) or service (for application-level SLOs) within a composite SLI calculation

CompositeSliMetricComponents.documentation: List of composite components that form a service-level or application-level SLI

ExpiresAt.documentation: For BREAKPOINT: optional, defaults to 24 hours, must be between 5 min and 24 hours For PROBE: optional, can be set for auto-cleanup or left null for permanent

InstrumentationType.documentation: Type of instrumentation configuration (BREAKPOINT or PROBE). Required to determine which table to delete from.

LocationIdentifier.documentation: Location identifier - either full code/watcher location or a pre-computed hash.

InstrumentationType.documentation: Type of instrumentation configuration (BREAKPOINT or PROBE). Required to determine which table to query.

LocationIdentifier.documentation: Location identifier - either full code/watcher location or a pre-computed hash.

InstrumentationType.documentation: Type of instrumentation configuration (BREAKPOINT or PROBE). Required to determine which table to query.

LocationIdentifier.documentation: Location identifier - either full code/watcher location or a pre-computed hash.

InstrumentationConfigurationArn.documentation: ARN for an instrumentation configuration Format: arn:${Partition}:application-signals:${Region}:${Account}:instrumentationConfig/${service}/${environment}/${signalType}/${locationHash} Note: service and environment can contain '/' and ':', so we use a permissive pattern that only validates the ARN prefix structure and the 16-character hex locationHash suffix.

InstrumentationType.documentation: Type of instrumentation configuration (BREAKPOINT or PROBE). Required to determine which backing store to query.

CodeLocation.documentation: The full code location specification (will be hashed internally)

WatcherLocation.documentation: The full watcher location specification (will be hashed internally)

LocationIdentifier.documentation: Union type for identifying an instrumentation configuration by code/watcher location or locationHash. Used in Get/Delete/GetStatus operations to allow flexible identification.

Endpoint.documentation: Either "*" or a concrete endpoint string without wildcard characters.
